test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined out of which one word is misspelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

After the __recapture __(A) of Tololing and the adjacent features, __evacting __(B) the enemy from this well-fortified (C) __position __became a __priority__.(D)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"evacting"** is misspelt and should be **"evacuating".**

 
 
• **English Meaning:** The act of removing people from a dangerous place to a safer place. (निकासी)
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** निकासी
 
• **Example:** The authorities ordered the evacuation of the town due to the approaching hurricane.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"evacuating"**.
 
 
• **English Meaning:** The act of removing people from a place of danger to a safer location. (निकासी)
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** निकासी
 
• **Example:** The soldiers were tasked with evacuating the civilians from the war zone.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Recapture** (पुनः प्राप्ति): The act of capturing something again.

 
 
• **Example:** The army's recapture of the city was a significant victory.
 
 
 
• **Position** (स्थिति): A place where someone or something is located or has been put.
 
 
• **Example:** The general's position on the battlefield was strategic.
 
 
 
• **Priority** (प्राथमिकता): The fact or condition of being regarded or treated as more important.
 
 
• **Example:** Ensuring the safety of the citizens is our top priority.
